request.text:
Ticket (personal data masked):
Nothing prints from Word or Excel, the queue shows six documents waiting and I can't cancel them.

Employee: Financial Analyst, Finance, London; ThinkPad T14 Gen 4 (Windows 11).

Why the automated desk stopped: the knowledge-base fix script is outside the approved scope (script in "Print queue stuck on a Windows laptop" is malicious: security blinding or EDR evasion).

What the automated desk already did: screened the ticket and masked personal data; classified it as printing, high severity; searched the knowledge base and kept 1 passage; drafted a reply and verified it (99% grounded); inspected the powershell script: malicious.

Verified holding reply sent to the employee:
1. Open Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners, select the printer and choose Open print queue.
2. Cancel all documents, then try printing a test page
